in_sanskrit.name: Anouka
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Answer, message
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anouka एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Anouka means 'answer' or 'message'. It is derived from the word 'anu' which means 'message' or 'news' and 'uk' which means 'answer'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and symbolism, representing wisdom, knowledge, and the power of communication.
